<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Abhiram P | Python & Django Developer</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500;12..96,700;12..96,800&family=Literata:opsz,wght@7..72,400;7..72,600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#EDF0F5; --surface:#FFFFFF; --ink:#1B2438; --muted:#55607A; --line:#CFD6E3;
  --panel:#2E3A52; --panel-ink:#E8ECF4; --accent:#E8912D; --accent-ink:#1B2438;
  --link:#2A5BD7;
  --display:"Bricolage Grotesque","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --body:"Literata",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    color-scheme:dark;
    --bg:#131A29; --surface:#1B2438; --ink:#EAEEF6; --muted:#A5AFC6; --line:#32405C;
    --panel:#0E1422; --panel-ink:#E8ECF4; --link:#8FB0FF;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#131A29; --surface:#1B2438; --ink:#EAEEF6; --muted:#A5AFC6; --line:#32405C;
  --panel:#0E1422; --panel-ink:#E8ECF4; --link:#8FB0FF;
}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1.0625rem/1.7 var(--body)}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display);line-height:1.1;margin:0}
a{color:var(--link)}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.25rem}
section{padding:4.5rem 0 0}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.3rem);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:1.5rem}

/* nav */
nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:1.25rem 0;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.mark{font:800 1.15rem var(--display);text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
nav ul{display:flex;gap:1.4rem;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font:500 .95rem var(--display)}
nav a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}

/* hero */
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:3rem;align-items:center;padding-top:2.5rem}
.me{display:block;width:120px;height:158px;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;border-radius:14px;border:4px solid var(--surface);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent);margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,8vw,5.2rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.hero .role{font:500 clamp(1.15rem,2.6vw,1.45rem)/1.35 var(--display);margin:1rem 0 1.25rem;color:var(--muted)}
.hero p{max-width:34rem;margin:0 0 1.75rem}
.btns{display:flex;gap:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{font:700 1rem var(--display);padding:.8rem 1.4rem;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;display:inline-block}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn.ghost{border:2px solid var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}

/* proctor viewfinder: the signature element */
.scope{background:var(--panel);color:var(--panel-ink);border-radius:14px;padding:1rem;font:500 .8rem var(--display)}
.scope .top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;opacity:.8;margin-bottom:.7rem}
.scope .top b{color:var(--accent)}
.feed{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3D4B69,#232C42);overflow:hidden}
.head{position:absolute;left:50%;top:22%;width:26%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:50%;background:#7E8CAB}
.body{position:absolute;left:50%;top:58%;width:52%;height:60%;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:50% 50% 0 0;background:#66749A}
.feed img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top}
.box{position:absolute;left:18%;top:3%;width:56%;height:72%;border:2px solid var(--accent);border-radius:4px}
.box::before{content:"Face matched: Abhiram";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);padding:.15rem .5rem;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:0 3px 0 0}
.sweep{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:var(--accent);opacity:0;top:0;animation:sweep 2.4s ease-out .4s 1 forwards}
@keyframes sweep{0%{top:0;opacity:.9}100%{top:100%;opacity:0}}
.log{margin-top:.8rem;display:grid;gap:.3rem;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.75rem;opacity:.9}
.log .warn{color:var(--accent)}

/* projects */
.proj{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:2rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.proj.feature{border-left:8px solid var(--accent)}
.proj h3{font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;margin:.9rem 0 1.2rem;padding:0;list-style:none}
.tags li{font:600 .85rem var(--display);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:.2rem .8rem;color:var(--muted)}
.proj ul.pts{margin:0;padding-left:1.2rem}
.proj ul.pts li{margin-bottom:.45rem}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.5rem}

/* skills */
.skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1.5rem}
.skills h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.skills ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.skills li{padding:.45rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

/* timeline */
.tl{border-left:3px solid var(--line);margin:0;padding:0 0 0 1.5rem;list-style:none}
.tl li{position:relative;padding-bottom:1.5rem}
.tl li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1.95rem;top:.55rem;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.tl b{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.1rem}
.tl span{display:block;color:var(--muted)}

footer{margin-top:5rem;background:var(--panel);color:var(--panel-ink);padding:3.5rem 0 3rem}
footer h2{margin-bottom:.8rem}
footer a{color:var(--panel-ink)}
footer .btn.primary{color:var(--accent-ink)}
footer small{display:block;margin-top:2.5rem;opacity:.6}

@media (max-width:820px){
  .hero,.cols,.skills{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .proj{padding:1.4rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sweep{animation:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <nav>
    <a class="mark" href="#top">Abhiram P</a>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="#projects">Projects</a></li>
      <li><a href="#skills">Skills</a></li>
      <li><a href="#education">Education</a></li>
      <li><a href="#contact">Contact</a></li>
    </ul>
  </nav>

  <header class="hero" id="top">
    <div>
      <img class="me" alt="Portrait of Abhiram P" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
      <h1>Abhiram P</h1>
      <p class="role">Python and Django developer building secure, AI-assisted web and mobile apps.</p>
      <p>I'm an MCA student and Computer Science graduate from Kerala. I build backends with Django and MySQL, apps with Flutter, and I like problems where software has to be both smart and trustworthy.</p>
      <div class="btns">
        <a class="btn primary" href="#projects">See my projects</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="mailto:abhiramp5565@gmail.com">Email me</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="scope" aria-label="Illustration of an AI proctoring camera feed">
      <div class="top"><span>Exam session 0142</span><b>Monitoring</b></div>
      <div class="feed" aria-hidden="true">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""><div class="box"></div><div class="sweep"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="log" aria-hidden="true">
        <span>10:42:07 Identity verified</span>
        <span>10:42:19 Candidate looking at screen</span>
        <span class="warn">10:43:02 Second face detected: alert sent</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </header>

  <section id="projects">
    <h2>Projects</h2>

    <article class="proj feature">
      <h3>AI Proctored Exam Portal</h3>
      <p>An online examination platform that lets students take exams remotely while the system watches for cheating, so invigilators don't have to.</p>
      <ul class="tags"><li>Python</li><li>Django</li><li>Flutter</li><li>MySQL</li></ul>
      <div class="cols">
        <div>
          <h3 style="font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:.5rem">What it does</h3>
          <ul class="pts">
            <li>Verifies the candidate with facial recognition.</li>
            <li>Monitors behavior and flags suspicious activity.</li>
            <li>Sends real-time alerts to the invigilator.</li>
            <li>Schedules exams and monitors students automatically.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div>
          <h3 style="font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:.5rem">How it's built</h3>
          <ul class="pts">
            <li>Django and MySQL handle the backend: users, exams, results.</li>
            <li>Flutter provides the student-facing app.</li>
            <li>AI modules run the face and behavior checks.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>

    <article class="proj">
      <h3>Automatic Annotation System</h3>
      <p>A web tool that speeds up labeling work by automating annotation, built with a Python backend and a browser interface.</p>
      <ul class="tags"><li>Python</li><li>HTML</li><li>CSS</li><li>JavaScript</li></ul>
    </article>
  </section>

  <section id="skills">
    <h2>Skills</h2>
    <div class="skills">
      <div><h3>Build</h3><ul><li>Python</li><li>Django</li><li>Flutter</li><li>MySQL</li></ul></div>
      <div><h3>Front end</h3><ul><li>HTML and JavaScript</li><li>Web design</li><li>Responsive design</li></ul></div>
      <div><h3>Working with people</h3><ul><li>Communication</li><li>Leadership</li><li>Teamwork</li><li>Problem solving</li></ul></div>
    </div>
    <p style="margin-top:1.5rem;color:var(--muted)">Languages: Malayalam, English, Tamil, Hindi.</p>
  </section>

  <section id="education">
    <h2>Education and experience</h2>
    <ul class="tl">
      <li><b>Master of Computer Applications (MCA)</b><span>University of Bangalore</span></li>
      <li><b>Internship</b><span>Riss Technologies, Calicut</span></li>
      <li><b>B.Sc. Computer Science</b><span>University of Calicut</span></li>
      <li><b>Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed)</b></li>
      <li><b>Higher Secondary, Computer Science</b></li>
    </ul>

    <h3 style="margin:1rem 0 .8rem;font-size:1.3rem">Certifications and awards</h3>
    <ul class="tags" style="margin-top:0">
      <li>Web Designing, ICS India Group of Institutions</li>
      <li>Cyber Security and Privacy, NPTEL (Swayam)</li>
      <li>NCC B Certificate</li>
      <li>Rajya Puraskar</li>
    </ul>
  </section>
</div>

<footer id="contact">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Let's work together</h2>
    <p>I'm looking for my first full-time role in software development. Write to me and I'll reply soon.</p>
    <div class="btns">
      <a class="btn primary" href="mailto:abhiramp5565@gmail.com">abhiramp5565@gmail.com</a>

</html>
